concept.meaning: At T, describe the admitted close path's escape and later re-entry geometry relative to each escape session's frozen prior-close envelope; this is descriptive path geometry, not Stage truth or an event backdated to the escape session.

representation_decision.why_measurement: The object is one T-ending Observation measuring path organization over a fixed admitted window. Its value may be a deterministic structured record; ObservationRevision binds a value digest and does not require a scalar payload.
representation_decision.event_rejected: Re-entry resolution may become known after the escape session and must not be backdated into an escape-time semantic fact.
representation_decision.process_rejected: E5 establishes no stable cross-T process identity or append-only start/progress/end lifecycle.
representation_decision.relation_rejected: The rolling prior-close envelopes are deterministic evaluation context rather than a separately governed anchor/target identity.
representation_decision.new_result_kind_rejected: The approved catalog type system is sufficient; structured_path_trace is not retained as a result kind.

measurement_value_schema.descriptors: deterministic summaries of the same event trace

claim_limits: Measurement classification does not imply scalarity, market validity, economic usefulness or Stage membership.
Escape/re-entry records are explanation components of the T-ending measurement and are not separately registered events.
Reserved catalog registration, if later approved, would remain naming/boundary authority only and would not grant runtime or market qualification.
